name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" guests for July 12, 2026
changes.summary: This week's guests include White House border czar Tom Homan and retired Gen. Frank McKenzie, president of The Citadel and former commander of U.S. Central Command.

changes.title: U.S. Employers Told to Dismiss Thousands of Immigrant Workers
changes.summary: Shifting deadlines are confusing businesses as the end of Temporary Protected Status for Haitians and others looms, making them ineligible to live and work in the United States.

changes.title: Trump Says Negotiations With Iran Will Continue as U.S. Ramps Up Strikes
changes.summary: U.S. forces hit more than 170 targets, including air defense systems, drone and missile storage sites, and military speedboats.

changes.title: Political scientist Dominic Tierney on why the U.S. gets trapped in conflicts like Iran
changes.summary: NPR's Scott Simon speaks with Swarthmore College political science professor Dominic Tierney about the U.S.-Iran war and other conflicts that have left the U.S. in drawn-out entanglements.

changes.title: An American Politician Is Blocked by Israeli Settlers in the West Bank
changes.summary: Representative Ro Khanna was barred from leaving for 90 minutes. Where past U.S. leaders toured the region to show support for Israel, today’s Democratic presidential aspirants are going to bolster their credentials as critics.

changes.title: U.S. Citizen Tests Positive for Ebola in Democratic Republic of Congo
changes.summary: The American, who works for the humanitarian organization Samaritan’s Purse, is the second to be infected in an outbreak that continues to spread.

changes.title: Trump warns Iran "missiles are locked and loaded" if they attempt assassination
changes.summary: President Trump threatened to "decimate and destroy" Iran if they try to assassinate him. This comes as the U.S. and Tehran continue negotiations. Here's what to know about where things stand.

changes.title: The biggest steam locomotive is whistle-stopping across the U.S.
changes.summary: Huge crowds of train fans turn out as the 1940s era Big Boy steam locomotive is making a rare trip cross country. (Image credit: Michelle Gustafson for NPR).

changes.title: U.S. citizen working for humanitarian organization in Congo tests positive for Ebola
changes.summary: The CDC said it was working with the person's employer, U.S. agencies, the public health authorities and Congolese partners to prevent further transmission and identify close contacts.

changes.title: Trump and Iran's supreme leader trade threats as mediators try to save their crumbling deal
changes.summary: President Donald Trump overnight made threats on social media of further missile attacks against Iran, after the funeral of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei saw open calls for the U.S. leader's killing.
